svg.title: Expense categories — SoftTrack web design mockup (#293)
svg.desc: A claim has an amount, a currency, a date, a description and a receipt, so what was spent on travel is answered by reading descriptions. Finance keeps a list of categories as rows; a new claim picks one; an approved claim keeps a copy of its category’s name; and reports show spend by category.
